Legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains how Arkan handles data on this website. Contact: {email}.
Legal.dataBody: We only collect what you submit via the project builder: name, email, and project configuration — to process your request and reply.
Legal.cookiesBody: We use an essential cookie (arkan_cookie_consent) for one year to store your consent choice, scoped to this site, with SameSite=Lax. We do not enable analytics or tracking before your explicit consent.
Legal.cookiesCategories: Categories: essential (always on), preferences (optional), and analytics (optional — not loaded until a vetted tool is added and you opt in).
Legal.retentionBody: We do not sell your data or share it for marketing. If a webhook is configured for form delivery, it is used only to route your request to our team over a secured channel.
Legal.rightsBody: You may request access, correction, or deletion of contact data via the email above. You can also change cookie consent anytime from the site footer or cookies page.
Legal.privacyBody: We only collect data you submit through the project builder to process your request. We do not sell your data. Contact: {email}.
Legal.termsIntro: By using the Arkan website you agree to the following terms. Project engagements are governed by a separate agreement.
Legal.termsUseBody: Content is provided to explain our services and projects. Commercial copying or republication requires written permission.
Legal.termsIpBody: The Arkan mark, copy, designs, and system descriptions are owned by or licensed to Arkan unless noted otherwise.
Legal.termsEngageBody: Submitting a blueprint does not create a contract. Scope, pricing, and timeline are defined in a written agreement before work begins.
Legal.termsLiabilityBody: We take reasonable care with marketing accuracy but do not warrant error-free materials. We are not liable for losses from relying on showcase content alone.
Legal.termsBody: Site content and project showcases are for marketing clarity. Scope, pricing, and delivery terms are defined in a separate agreement before any engagement begins.
